verdict.rationale: Stripe's spending-controls docs confirm platform-enforced limits per authorization or per month, plus category, country, merchant, and card-presence blocks. The agents docs also cite spend controls as a built-in feature. The evidence does not show per-cardholder versus per-card scoping, daily or all-time windows, or transaction-count velocity rules. Missing for 10: per-card and per-cardholder scoping evidence, daily and all-time interval limits, transaction-count velocity controls, independent hands-on corroboration.
